summary: Not locked out. Pushed off the convenient route.

items.task: Using Government24 and Hometax at all
items.note: Joint certificates and financial certificates remain available, so 'no Korean number means no access' is wrong.

items.task: Simple authentication (PASS, Kakao, Naver, Toss, bank apps)
items.note: The National Tax Service supports these on Hometax, extended in 2026 to business users as well as individuals. This is the route a passport-only line loses.
PASS does not exclude foreign residents; it requires a line that supports phone identity verification, and some MVNOs restrict exactly that.

source: National Tax Service simple authentication support on Hometax; PASS foreigner eligibility guidance
